So now the Dog, with a posse expanded to include his children and grandchildren, sets off on a hunt through the Colorado Rockies for Santa Claus himself!

episodes:992.name: Call Waiting
episodes:992.summary: Dog's target for today has been in trouble with the law since he was a juvenile. And he seems willing to use any trick in the system to avoid capture by Dog. In this match of wits, will Dog prevail?

episodes:992.name: Kid Stuff
episodes:992.summary: A fugitive from justice is on the lam and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address. The posse's one hope is to locate his girlfriend and convince her to help bring him in. Will a tip from some local kids tip the scales in Dog's favor?

episodes:992.name: Easy Does It
episodes:992.summary: There is a running joke in the posse that every time Bobby Brown asks them for help with a fugitive he always promises them that it's "an easy one," but the hunts end up being epic searches. So it's with a huge grain of salt that they listen to his guarantee that today's hunt will "really be an easy one." Will today finally be the day?

episodes:992.name: Ghost Rider
episodes:992.summary: Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out. But an unexpected turn of events proves that even Dog and crew can be surprised.

episodes:992.name: Back in the Hood
episodes:992.summary: Dog doesn't know it yet, but today's bounty is about to take him on a trip down memory lane and test his investigative chops. With each lead propelling him closer and closer to his childhood haunts, Dog uses old-fashioned detective skills to track his prey. Even examining a suspect's rubbish in a masterful example of "garbology" to uncover a hot lead.

episodes:992.name: One for the Road
episodes:992.summary: Dog is a big-hearted guy and today he's proving it. He's helping Mary Ellen, his friend and fellow bondsman, on a dangerous night hunt for a fugitive she is now regretting bailing out. He's also giving his nephew Justin a second chance to rejoin the team. And if that isn't enough, Dog's also making a special visit to lift the spirits of a young boy facing numerous medical challenges.

episodes:992.name: Bait and Switch (1)
episodes:992.summary: Things are seldom what they seem in the world of bounty hunting and it is through this maze of illusions that Dog pursues his prey. When the fugitive's girlfriend offers to help Dog trap this dangerous felon Dog knows that someone is being deceived, the only question is whom?

episodes:992.name: True Identity
episodes:992.summary: Dog knows that looks can be deceiving and today's hunt makes this point crystal clear. The fugitive is pretty, petite, and trouble. She stands accused of settling an argument with the help of a box cutter. What Dog does not anticipate is how deceptive this femme fatale can truly be!

episodes:992.name: Secrets and Lies
episodes:992.summary: What do you do when you have a fugitive you not only want to find, but believe can be helped back onto the straight and narrow? If you're Mary Ellen you call you good friend Dog. He not only has the ruthless tenacity to hunt down the most elusive of prey, but also the generousness of heart to offer hope to the most desperate.

episodes:992.name: Match Point
episodes:992.summary: The day starts with Duane Lee and Leland facing off in the kind of court rarely associated with the Chapmans...a tennis court. At stake, as always, are bragging rights for which son can claim the title of "Chapman Champ." But before a winner is declared duty calls and they are off on a hunt with Dog. The team chases a fugitive who has disappeared into a world of "no known" addresses. If they catch her she will be facing off with an opponent in very different kind of court.

episodes:992.name: Menehune Mischief
episodes:992.summary: When Beth returns to the compound on the Big Island she finds a damaged SUV and two possible culprits--Dog or Justin. Pressed by Beth, Dog offers a third option. The perpetrators are Hawaii's mythical mischief makers--the Menehune! As the team pursues their fugitive over volcanic mountain ranges and into the unmapped wilds of Puna, Dog regales the team with the lore of these magical beings. He also makes a promise: after catching their man he that will reveal the identity of the real mischief maker.

episodes:992.name: Mister Mom
episodes:992.summary: It's been quite a while since Tim Chapman put down his mace can and bulletproof vest to care for his growing family. When his old friend Dog calls asking for help tracking an elusive felon Tim jumps into action. Can he shake off the cobwebs and man-up for a bust or has he spent too many days being mister mom?

episodes:992.name: Bait & Snitch
episodes:992.summary: When the local cops put out an APB for a client with a checked past, Dog springs into action. With the aid of the runner's girlfriend the posse heads out to bring him in. Little does the team suspect that before the end of the day Dog will be helping to mend a family torn apart by violence.

episodes:992.name: Scared Straight
episodes:992.summary: Back in Colorado Dog tracks a fugitive who is on the run from the law for the first time. Reading the file Dog knows the young man's life is at the crossroads. He can either get back on the straight and narrow or careen down the road to wreck and ruin. Will Dog's posse be able to track down this wanna-be-gansta in time to convince him to make the right choice?

episodes:992.name: All My Children (1)
episodes:992.summary: For a guy who started life as a free spirited outlaw-biker Dog has certainly turned into a family man. His children touch everything he does today, from searching for the perfect gift for his daughter Cecily's birthday to hunting a fugitive with a surprisingly intimate connection with his estranged son Tucker. Dog ends the day surrounded by family and friends celebrating Cecily's 16th birthday.

episodes:992.name: Rumble in the Jungle (1)
episodes:992.summary: Only in Dog's world would a bantam fighting rooster, a pregnant daughter, and a jungle safe house go together. And don't forget the mopeds as well a group of hostile squatters on government land! They're all part of the hunt for an elusive and clever criminal that takes Dog through the parts of Hawaii that tourists never get to see.

episodes:992.name: Bounty Baby (1)
episodes:992.summary: What's a father to do? When the cops ask Dog for help tracking down a renegade teen with a history of running hard, Baby Lyssa, eight months pregnant and counting, insists on joins the hunt. Can Dog keep his daughter safe and catch his man in time for Lyssa to make it to the hospital, or will this baby be born on the bounty?

episodes:992.name: Rain Check (1)
episodes:992.summary: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first. When another bondsman calls needing help tracking down a hardened con recently sprung from the Big House, Dog leads the crew into the wilds of the Big Island in hot pursuit. Will he get his man? Will Beth get her night on the town or add another rain check to her already large collection?

episodes:992.name: Love on the Run
episodes:992.summary: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that since she disappeared she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the attention of local media. Word on the street is that they are on the run together. In this case love isn't the answer--in fact, it might be the problem.

episodes:992.name: Jump Start
episodes:992.summary: A big heart can be a problem for a bail bondsman and today's hunt is a case in point. Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run. Now Dog has to track him down. Can he also set him right?

episodes:992.name: The Ice Man (1)
episodes:992.summary: Dog's latest fugitive, doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of methamphetamine when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado. Dog and his team track him through rundown trailer parks, junkyards filled with rusted cars, and finally to a desolate country road where they have to make a risky nighttime bust.

episodes:992.name: Trouble in Paradise (1)
episodes:992.summary: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man. Finally a hot tip sends Dog and team to a volcanic moonscape and a midnight raid.

episodes:992.name: Girl Power
episodes:992.summary: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

episodes:992.name: Prodigal Son
episodes:992.summary: Fugitive beware: Dog's rolling with extra power today. His old friends Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man. But once he finds him will Dog be able to work his magic and help heal this fractured family?

episodes:992.name: Family Ties
episodes:992.summary: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all. As the team closes in on their target Dog begins to doubt her story. Will Dog find himself facing a violent offender or just a young man more in need of tough love than serious jail time?

episodes:992.name: Special Delivery
episodes:992.summary: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The team whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of this imposing 300-pound felon. Then, a late-night call kicks Dog and crew into high gear. Is the lead legit?

episodes:992.name: Surface Scratches
episodes:992.summary: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another. With an assist from the bail bonds community, Dog plots to capture his prey in an arrest by appointment. But when Dog thinks the arrest is about to happen he is met with a man in a late-model sports car and a pocket full of cash. Is the hunt over or is it just beginning?

episodes:992.name: The Great Debate
episodes:992.summary: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel. But sometimes the defendant is a threat to the community and the cosigner asks the bondsman for protection. When Leland finds himself with a confusing case, Dog comes up with a unique plan to find out where the truth lies, and if freedom or jail is in the defendant's future.

episodes:992.name: Facebooked
episodes:992.summary: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one. But as the hunt unfolds Dog discovers a new source--the facebook status of the girlfriend of the fugitive. Will the new social network give Dog the information he needs to capture his prey? Can this Dog learn new tricks?

episodes:992.name: Mano-a-Mano
episodes:992.summary: Back in Colorado, Dog`s on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law. But the fugitive's friends and family are reluctant to help Dog bring him in. Closing in on the one location they have, Dog knows he may have a family feud on his hands as he tries to bring this felon to justice.

episodes:992.name: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown (1)
episodes:992.summary: After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.

episodes:992.name: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown (2)
The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown (3)
The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown (4)
The Comeback Kid (1)
episodes:992.summary: Dog is back in Colorado chasing a young man with a taste for trouble. He's fled to Texas but with his family's house on the line Dog is willing to try a risky strategy. He enlists the family in an elaborate hoax to lure the runner home. With Dog tutoring them in the art of deceit the scam begins. Will his new pupils prove fast learners or will their divided loyalties undo the plan?

episodes:992.name: Tent City (1)
episodes:992.summary: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit. With no known address and only tips from questionable sources, Dog heads out to bring her to justice and try to bring hope back to her life.

episodes:992.name: Dead of Night (1)
episodes:992.summary: This hunt is personal. Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors. When the clock striking midnight a new lead comes in. Will this informant prove anymore reliable than the rest?

episodes:992.name: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1 (1)
episodes:992.summary: A small town bondsmen is in over his head, his business on the line, when he makes a desperate plea for help. Dog agrees and launches a high stake hunt through the desolate and dangerous mountain landscape of western Colorado in pursuit of a gun-loving survivalist with a million dollar bond on his head. Will Dog's plan of using brains over brawn work?

episodes:992.name: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1 (2)
The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2 (1)
episodes:992.summary: Once in Montrose, Dog discovers that the million dollar fugitive is not the young bondsman's only problem. His kind heart and inexperience have led him to bail out a bevy of bail jumpers. Dog and Beth make it their mission to both clean up the mess and teach him the fundamentals of bondsmanship.

episodes:992.name: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2 (2)
The Montrose Files: From Dawn till Dusk (1)
The Montrose Files: From Dawn till Dusk (2)
The Montrose Files: The More the Merrier (1)
The Montrose Files: The More the Merrier (2)
Oh Brother, Where Art Thou? (1)
episodes:992.summary: With a long record of violence and abuse and weighing in at over 200lbs, Dog's target for the day does not sound like a gentle giant. When the trail grows cold Dog turns up the heat on the fugitive's brother and sister. Will Dog's relentless ruthlessness force the siblings to turn on their bad news brother?

episodes:992.name: Cap and Gown (1)
episodes:992.summary: Other than bringing criminals to justice, one of Dog's loves is teaching the next generation of bounty hunters the tricks of the trade. Today he has a new student. Friend of the family, Kili, is joining the team to help track down a runner on the Hawaiian island of Maui. This is not the only thing on their schedule, because after the hunt, Kili has to hurry off to his college graduation ceremony!

episodes:992.name: And Baby Makes Three (1)
episodes:992.summary: Leland has to attend a Lamaze class before he can join the hunt--another Chapman is on the way! But when Dog starts to go after this accused jewelry thief without his fastest son, he learns that this fugitive puts the "R" in runner. Dog now knows that only Leland's fleet feet can catch this criminal. And when the fugitive is finally cornered, Leland is in for the fight of his life!

episodes:992.name: The Tender Trap (1)
episodes:992.summary: Dog is up in the high plains of Colorado helping a fellow bondman bring his most elusive fugitives to justice. When Dog discovers today's prey is a notorious ladies man, he knows just how to lure him in. The trap includes a suggestive phone call, a motel rendezvous, and a crew of bounty hunters waiting in the next room ready to break up the party!

episodes:992.name: Greed is Good (1)
episodes:992.summary: Today's fugitive is accused of assaulting a police officer, so Dog and the team are not taking any chances. While on the Big Island and Dog convinces the felon's friends and family to join forces and then learns he has fled to another island. So Dog has to play on his target's greed and deploy some modern technology to set a trap for this runner.

episodes:992.name: Tears for Fears (1)
episodes:992.summary: There are few louder wake-up calls than coming-to in a jail cell with no idea how you got there. Add the media splashing the news of your arrest on every TV channel, and if your name is Lyssa Chapman you know you are in for a rough day. Surprisingly, when this happens to Baby Lyssa, she steps-up and befriends a woman who is waging a very personal battle against drug addiction.

episodes:992.name: Picture This
episodes:992.summary: A fugitive with a long criminal record has fled to Hawaii, and the bondsman on the mainland has asked Dog and the Posse for help. Dog doesn't have much information to work with, but he can use the felon's desire to impress his friends to track him down.

episodes:992.name: Tag, You're It
episodes:992.summary: They say you can't teach an old dog new tricks but that's not the case with "Dog" Chapman. To his traditional bounty hunting tools of confidential informants, canvassing, and silver-tongued subterfuge the world's greatest bounty hunter has added Facebook! A word to the wise for those on the run-post at your own peril, the Dog is watching!

episodes:992.name: A Family Affair (1)
episodes:992.summary: Dog likes to say, "The apple doesn't fall far from the tree," and this is a hunt where that is true. So will Dog be able to use one family member's troubled ways to catch another one in trouble with the law?

episodes:992.name: Training Day
episodes:992.summary: It takes years to become a seasoned bondsman, and the tenderfoot Alysin has a lot to learn. She not only bailed out a man facing charges of theft on just his promise to pay the fee but also without a co-signer for his bond. And sparks fly between Beth and Duane Lee when he questions Beth's decision to go on the hunt with Dog leading the charge!

episodes:992.name: Cutting the Apron Strings
episodes:992.summary: Two different young men; one has a taste for larceny, the other for strong sprits, both have a bad bad habit of missing their court dates. Looking over their files Dog senses that they have another trait in common, both are a little too tied to their mothers. Dog makes it part of his mission to offer some fatherly advice to these wanted men.

episodes:992.name: Short Handed
episodes:992.summary: Dog is in Colorado helping a fellow bondsmen clean up his files. The target today has a history of violence, and apparently plans to re-locate without notifying the proper authorities. Unfortunately the team is missing a key player, Duane Lee is MIA today distracted by his new lady love.

episodes:992.name: Photo Op
episodes:992.summary: Dog and Duane Lee can't agree about what role Duane Lee should have in the family business, and the simmering tensions come to a head when Duane Lee is accused of denting Dog's SUV. But the family comes together as they set out to hunt a chronic violator with an open warrant and a wife who has an odd request for Dog.

episodes:992.name: A House Divided
episodes:992.summary: Dog has dropped Duane Lee from the team, and Leland is feeling caught in the middle. When Leland confronts Dog and Beth about the decision tempers flare. But they have to come together to answer a cry for help from a mother who feels that the safest place for her daughter is jail.

episodes:992.name: All Grown Up
episodes:992.summary: Cecily has graduated from High School and Dog believes the time is right to show her what the family business is all about. The rough and tumble world of bounty hunting is very different than the all girls private school she attended and Cecily is reluctant to hit the mean streets with Dog. But by days end a Chapman is a Chapman.

episodes:992.name: Fight Like a Girl
episodes:992.summary: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

episodes:992.name: A Higher Power
episodes:992.summary: In a last ditch attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker. As Dog begins his hunt for a young man who has trouble showing up at court, Tim has his own mission--convince Duane Lee to meet with him.

episodes:992.name: Ties That Bind
episodes:992.summary: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound or make it worse? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

episodes:992.name: Who's the Boss
episodes:992.summary: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

episodes:992.name: Bus Stop Bruiser
episodes:992.summary: When an alleged abuser goes on the lame Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

episodes:992.name: Luck Be a Lady (1)
episodes:992.summary: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California. As Dog investigates the whereabouts of one missing lady, they head out in search of the other. Will luck be a lady for Dog or will the team be the ones busted?

episodes:992.name: Behind the Scenes (1)
episodes:992.summary: Previously unseen footage and interviews with Dog, his posse and the show's crew.

episodes:992.name: God Looks on the Heart
episodes:992.summary: This fugitive's sketchy associates and footloose ways spell trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. As dusk turns to night Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

episodes:992.name: Big Brother
episodes:992.summary: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in. Dog's plan is to convince family that everyone is best served if the fugitive mans-up and takes care of business. But when the crew raids the family's home, voices are raised, temperatures flare, and Dog's best-laid plan begins to resemble a hope and a pray.

episodes:992.name: Mid-Course Correction
episodes:992.summary: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul. But Dog also has new trouble brewing inside his own family -- can he catch this fugitive and keep the team together?

show:witness for the prosecution.name: The Witness for the Prosecution
show:witness for the prosecution.summary: Thrilling two-part drama about a man accused of killing his lover in order to inherit her wealth. Based on Agatha Christie's classic book.

episodes:23117.name: Episode 1
episodes:23117.summary:
1920s London. A murder, brutal and bloodthirsty, has stained the plush carpets of a handsome London townhouse - the victim is the beautiful widow Emily French.

All evidence points to Leonard, a dashing young chancer who seduced the older woman into leaving him her vast fortune before ruthlessly taking her life. At least, this is the story that Emily's distraught, devoted housekeeper Janet stands by in court.

Mayhew, a penniless solicitor, is put in charge of Leonard's case. Initially treating the suspect with indifference, Mayhew is gradually moved by the young man's case. Leonard is certain that his innocence can be proved by his wife, the enigmatic chorus girl Romaine. The entire case rests on her alibi, and Mayhew is reassured to learn that she witnessed Leonard return at 9.30pm, the time when he supposedly murdered Emily.

Will she testify and save her husband or will his infidelity make her vengeful?

episodes:23117.name: Episode 2
episodes:23117.summary:
Romaine, whose testimony was Leonard's one hope to save him from the gallows, has turned on him, leaving Mayhew's case hopeless and Leonard's fatal verdict imminent.

Nonetheless Mayhew's firm belief in Leonard's innocence spurs him on, with a steely conviction.

Mayhew desperately tries to discredit Romaine and even to lay the blame on Emily's obsessive housekeeper Janet, whose word is the bulwark of evidence keeping Leonard behind bars. His efforts stall, leaving Mayhew on the verge of defeat…

But there is another, shadowy player in this vicious game - one who turns the entire case on its head and changes both his and Leonard's life forever.

show:colors.name: Mitsuboshi Colors
show:colors.summary: The "Colors" are three cute little girls who hang out together and say they're protecting the peace of their city. They have lots of fun together, doing stuff like playing games, solving puzzles, and going to the zoo. This anime follows their largely happy daily life.

previousepisode.name: Colors, the Town, and the People

episodes:33887.name: Colors, the Town, and the People

previousepisode.name: The Man with the Saltwater Socks

episodes:58483.name: The Man with the Saltwater Socks

show:the long goodbye.name: The Long Goodbye
show:the long goodbye.summary: Based on the same-titled novel by Raymond Chandler, the drama is set in Tokyo, in the 1950's. Harada Tamotsu was suspected of murdering his wife, the actress Harada Shizuka. He then fled to Taiwan and had apparently committed suicide over there. However, Tamotsu's friend Masuzawa Banji, who works as a private detective, has doubts about Tamotsu's death, but the incident is hushed up by Harada Heizo, a powerful media mogul. Soon after, Masuzawa is pulled into another case involving the neighbors of the Harada family, a drunk novelist Kamiido Joji. His investigations lead him to a publishing company editor, Haneoka, and to the sister of the murdered Shizuka, Takamura Yoshino. Most but not least, he is introduced to Joji's beautiful wife, Aiko, who seems to be the key to both the cases.

episodes:46194.name: When She Goes Up The Stairs

show:fatal attraction.name: Fatal Attraction
show:fatal attraction.summary: Each pulse-pounding hour-long episode of Fatal Attraction centers around an incredible and dangerous romance. Shocking crime, kidnapping or even murder is only half of the story! In the end, the "true love" that draws these couples together isn't the kind that celebrates silver anniversaries – instead it leads to cross-country manhunts, bizarre cover-ups and dramatic trials. Driven by powerful, real-life stories, Fatal Attraction weaves together intimate, first-person interviews, exclusive interrogation footage and rare archival material. Along the way, it gives you a glimpse into the dark heart of a dangerous romance. Listen as the key players, family of the survivors and those that investigated the horrific crimes reveal the secrets to each sordid tale. Fatal Attraction…because love doesn't just hurt. It can kill!

episodes:4887.name: With This Bullet, I Thee Kill
episodes:4887.summary: A twisted love triangle is uncovered in the opener of this series examining crimes of passion.

episodes:4887.name: Broken Vows, Bloody Murder
episodes:4887.summary: A pastor's wife is murdered outside their Houston home.

episodes:4887.name: Prisoner of Love
episodes:4887.summary: Jealousy and obsession destroy a couple's romance.

episodes:4887.name: A Devil in Uniform
episodes:4887.summary: A web of secrets and lies is uncovered after a woman goes missing.

episodes:4887.name: Shopping for Murder
episodes:4887.summary: An obsession with money tears a couple apart.

episodes:4887.name: Blazing Fury
episodes:4887.summary: A woman who found romance online suddenly goes missing.

episodes:4887.name: Till Death Do Us Part
episodes:4887.summary: A horrendous crime tears a couple apart.

episodes:4887.name: A Cry in the Dark
episodes:4887.summary: A murder is uncovered as police search for a missing couple.

episodes:4887.name: Ambushed by Love
episodes:4887.summary: Craig and Cynthia Anderson were madly in love, but it wasn't long before their fairytale romance was put to the test. When a man intrudes on the Anderson's property, they gun him down and claim self-defense. However, when he survives the incident, investigators learn there may be more to this story than meets the eye.

episodes:4887.name: The Devil Beside Me
episodes:4887.summary: Winston and Darlene George seemed to have the perfect marriage, but a tragic act of violence would rip them apart forever. When investigators begin to search for answers, they discover a tangled web of sex, lies, and greed.

episodes:4887.name: Collegiate Killing
episodes:4887.summary: A bright future and a loving fiancée, grad student Denita Smith seemed to have it all…until she was found at the bottom of her stairs, a bullet hole in the back of her head. Who would want to kill Denita?

episodes:4887.name: The Sinner and the Saint
episodes:4887.summary: Kristopher Miller and Kim Griffin had just begun their steamy new romance when a tragic crime would stop it dead in its tracks. Investigators initially expect the crime to be linked to gang violence, which is prevalent in the area. However, after digging deeper they discover a chilling tale of jealousy and vengeance.

episodes:4887.name: Murder in Niagara
episodes:4887.summary: On the surface, Robert and Ahkenya Johnson had a picture perfect marriage. But according to friends and family, Robert's behavior had become increasingly erratic. When the mother of two is found by her husband was he the last person to see her alive? He's got an alibi, but will it convince authorities and Ahkenya's family?

episodes:4887.name: Tragic Rebound
episodes:4887.summary: Tamika Huston had big dreams of becoming a singer and a promising future ahead of her, but when she inexplicably goes missing, friends and family worry they'll never get to see her reach her full potential. The search for answers will lead law enforcement down a slew of different paths—will they ever be able to track down this beautiful young songstress?

episodes:4887.name: Hell Hath No Fury
episodes:4887.summary: Brian and Elicia Hughes seemed to have a picture perfect marriage; high school sweethearts with two daughters and a nice home in an affluent neighborhood. But when a 911 call leads to a disturbing crime, their perfect life turns up to be not so perfect.

episodes:4887.name: Sins & Secrets
episodes:4887.summary: Pastor Anthony Hopkins and his wife, Arletha, were living their dreams with their seven beautiful children. Years later, someone comes forward with a shocking revelation that will prove there was more to Arletha's death than anyone could ever imagine.

episodes:4887.name: Budding Bloodsheed
episodes:4887.summary: Tiffany and Antwan fell head over heels in love for each other, but once Tiffany had Antwan's child, she found starting a family in high school was far from easy. And when an argument between the two lovers leaves Antwan dead, everyone's wondering what could push this girl to kill her first love.

episodes:4887.name: Raging Revenge
episodes:4887.summary: Tawanna Barnes-Copeland seemed to have it all – three beautiful daughters and a budding romance. Until one fateful day when her daughter came home to find the unthinkable. The investigation would leave detectives wondering – was Tawanna the victim of a deadly robbery? Or was there someone out there who wanted her dead?

episodes:4887.name: Horror on the Highway
episodes:4887.summary: The story of Ryan and Serika Holness begins in Jamaica, but ends tragically in a Maryland field. Ryan's reports of a carjacker sends police on a manhunt but when detectives add up the evidence, they start to believe the killer may be closer than they think.

episodes:4887.name: If I Can't Have You
episodes:4887.summary: When dashing young Michael Brooks falls for a sexy older woman named Dorothy Washington, their desire for each other can't be contained. But when Michael is brutally gunned down inside Dorothy's apartment, their steamy romance would be forever put on hold. As law enforcement attempt to piece together what happened, they uncover a twisted tale of lies, jealousy, and violence.

episodes:4887.name: Fallen Hero
episodes:4887.summary: When Officer Wayne Irby stops by Denise Miller's home on a courtesy call, she falls hard for the man in uniform. But when both Wayne and Denise turn up missing, his fellow officers find out just how mad love can be!

episodes:4887.name: Texas Tragedy
episodes:4887.summary: When beautiful young coed Tynesha Stewart goes missing just miles from her boyfriend's apartment, her family and friends grow more anxious by the hour. But a shocking confession from a familiar face not only divulges Tynesha's fate, but also the presence of a true monster, and a sickening crime.

episodes:4887.name: A Lethal Love Affair
episodes:4887.summary: Latrese Curtis's stabbed corpse turns up beside a highway, days after her wedding to husband Darin. As investigators begin to probe into the case, they unveil a tortuous web of sex, deception and scandal that shocks even the most jaded among them.

episodes:4887.name: Burning Rage
episodes:4887.summary: Pregnant Detroiter Latonya Bowman is abducted, immolated, shot and left to die.As she and her unborn son struggle to recover, detectives try to determine who would want to do this to her. A murder plot of shocking proportions slowly emerges.

episodes:4887.name: All in the Family
episodes:4887.summary: Nurse Kenyatae Collier-Brewer - a wife and mother of three - vanishes sans explanation. Her husband Darron immediately informs the police, who locate her abandoned vehicle and plunge into a web of deception and cover-ups.

episodes:4887.name: Harvard Homicide
episodes:4887.summary: Co-eds Jabrai Copney and Brittany Smith enjoyed a fairy tale romance until 2009, when a young man turned up dead on campus, and Brittany also vanished. Investigators soon uncovered a bizarre web of lies and double-crosses that led straight to conviction.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Rampage
episodes:4887.summary: Shanda Merritt and Carl Davis became a 21st century Bonnie and Clyde given their taste for crime. Then Carl left Shanda and attempted to go straight. This triggered a domino-like series of vile actions that killed one man and put another at death's door.

episodes:4887.name: Love Triangle Tragedy
episodes:4887.summary: 22-year-old Erika Yancey vanishes, prompting a massive search. An airport baggage handler with a penchant for meeting men online, she is no stranger to risk. But soon the investigation leads in another direction and unveils a fatal love affair.

episodes:4887.name: Pure Evil
episodes:4887.summary: Nova Henry and Eddy Curry's relationship hits the skids when Eddy gets drafted to the NBA and saddles Nova with two children. Then Nova and her infant daughter Ava turn up dead in the middle of an ugly custody battle, and investigators are baffled.

episodes:4887.name: Millionaire Murder
episodes:4887.summary: Atlanta businessman-playboy Lance Herndon is found bludgeoned to death in his bathroom in August 1996. As investigators delve into his personal life, they encounter a number of angry and jealous mistresses, any one of whom could be the culprit.

episodes:4887.name: Toxic Romance
episodes:4887.summary: Reginald Daye falls helplessly in love with Crystal Magnum. He sees their union as kismet, but is stabbed to death in his home not long after.The subsequent investigation unearths a scandalous and long-buried secret in the community of Durham.

episodes:4887.name: California Cold Case
episodes:4887.summary: Marie Singleton disappears in late 1994, after falling for Andre Jackson and conceiving his child. The ensuing investigation stretches out over decades until a discovery solves the case and suggests that Marie may have been at risk from the beginning.

episodes:4887.name: Lethal Liaison
episodes:4887.summary: Cicely Bolden is stabbed to death in the wake of a sexual romance with Larry Dunn. Investigators look into the case and discover many buried secrets and a shocking conclusion.

episodes:4887.name: Feast of the Flesh
episodes:4887.summary: When Manny and Exondia first met, sparks immediately began to fly. It wasn't long before the couple's sensual romance blossomed into something more—they were soon having a baby and getting married. But only five years into their blissful union, Manny would go inexplicably missing, ripping the life of this happy couple apart at the seams. Exondia is crushed when the investigation into Manny's disappearance reveals a sordid secret—he was having an affair. Investigators wonder if Exondia's husband could have run off to start a new life with this other woman…but could there be a more sinister reason for Manny's disappearance?

episodes:4887.name: Law and Murder
episodes:4887.summary: Chancy Jones and Phyllis Malone never expected to find love as a result of a domestic violence call, but that's exactly what happened. When Chancy, a Memphis police officer, comes to Phyllis' rescue, the dashing knight-in-shining-armor and beautiful damsel-in-distress have an instant connection. It isn't long before a sexy romance ignites, and it appears nothing can tear the couple apart. But Chancy and Phyllis' flame is swiftly put out when she's discovered murdered inside her vehicle. Is it possible her past of domestic violence has come back to haunt her? Or could Phyllis' search for love have awoken something much worse…

episodes:4887.name: A Sinister Affair
episodes:4887.summary: Yamisha Thomas and Sylvester Davis had chemistry that couldn't be tamed. Sparks flew in the bedroom, and Sylvester was a great father figure for Yamisha's young daughter. Just when it seemed their relationship couldn't get more perfect, Yamisha goes inexplicably missing after she fails to pick up her daughter from a family member's home. Detectives are puzzled as to what could've happened to this beautiful young mother. The investigation into her disappearance will reveal some alarming secrets, and beg the question…did her past come back to haunt her?

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Secret
episodes:4887.summary: "Cece" Dove was a vivacious young woman looking for love. But when she mysteriously disappears, investigators can't help but wonder if her online dating profile could have landed her in the hands of an internet predator. And when, on the other side of town, the body of a male is discovered, the victim of a heinous murder, investigators make an incredible discovery causing the cases to collide in the most shocking of ways.

episodes:4887.name: Dance of Death
episodes:4887.summary: Debbie Flores-Narvaez was a beautiful showgirl looking to fall in love. But when she vanishes without a trace, investigators can't help but wonder if she had gotten caught up in the lifestyle of the night and had ended up as just another of the lost souls missing from the City of Sin. But when Debbie's car turns up across town, investigators uncover a love triangle involving the reigning queen of the Vegas showgirls and a dark secret so lurid it could be worth killing for.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Jealousy
episodes:4887.summary: Jennifer Lewis never expected that she'd have a relationship as meaningful as the one she had with God, but that changed when she met the charming and devout, Melvin Reed. And soon a fast and deep romance blossomed, held together by their mutual love of God. But Jennifer and Melvin's romance is snuffed out prematurely when Jennifer is shot on campus at close-range. Is it possible a secret from her past has come back to haunt her or had her search for love put her in contact with something much more sinister…

episodes:4887.name: The Boy Is Mine
episodes:4887.summary: Curtisha Morning was an ambitious young student focused on her career and not her love life But that all changed when she met Brown. Carl opened up a new exciting world that Curtisha had never experienced. But when Curtisha vanishes into thin air, investigators are at a loss for what could have happened to the ambitions young teen. But soon a dark secret is exposed, one so reprehensible it just might prove motive for murder.

episodes:4887.name: Mortal Matrimony
episodes:4887.summary: For Juatasha Denton, failure was not in her vocabulary. She always got what she wanted in life and love, and what she wanted most was Ray McCaster. And soon innocent flirtations turned into full-blown romance and they ended up tying the knot. But their happy world of married bliss is shattered when a dismembered body is found just miles from the couple's house. Investigators are about to uncover a secret so dark it may just have brought the young lovers on a collision course with evil.

episodes:4887.name: AWOL Abduction
episodes:4887.summary: When Kimberly Parker said "I do" to, Elihue Parker, he promised her the world. But their dreams for a bright future are dashed when Elihue turns up missing. As investigators delve deeper, they uncover a twisted ring of greed and deception that will leave them face to face with pure evil.

episodes:4887.name: Heart of Darkness
episodes:4887.summary: When Wynetta Wright met hard-nosed cop Richmond Phillips, sparks flew right away and soon they were embroiled in a heated romance. Nine months later, Wynetta had given birth to their daughter, Jaylin. But nearly a year later, their hopes of happiness are soon dashed as both Wynetta and baby Jaylin unexpectedly disappear. As investigators delve deeper into Wynetta and Jaylin's disappearance they find themselves suddenly caught in a sordid web of love and lust, bringing them face to face with an evil that can't be named.

episodes:4887.name: Last Act
episodes:4887.summary: When local actress Pasinetta Prince met charmer, Patrick Bauldwin, he fanned her flame and together they formed the perfect partnership. But the curtain dropped on their love affair when Pasinetta was found strangled in her own home. And as investigators wade through the cast of suspects, they soon uncover a sordid secret that will rattle the community to its core.

episodes:4887.name: Dangerous Addiction
episodes:4887.summary: When navy veteran, Eric Clark met gorgeous Constance Harris a friendship developed that soon shot into the stratosphere of love. Marriage quickly followed. But their dreams of happiness were cut short when Eric did not make it back home from a trip to Atlanta and is later found shot to death. As investigators delve into the case, they are soon led on a frenzied manhunt for a diabolical killer, in the process revealing a murky world where greed and betrayal take the front seat.

episodes:4887.name: A Flaming Hot Fling
episodes:4887.summary: An ex-running back is killed in a suspicious fire.

episodes:4887.name: Big Rig Rage
episodes:4887.summary: A truck driver is shot to death in the sleeping compartment of her rig.

episodes:4887.name: Bayou Bloodshed
episodes:4887.summary: A high-profile attorney is found murdered in her office.

episodes:4887.name: Innocence Slaughtered
episodes:4887.summary: A popular teen is stabbed to death after meeting an older basketball star.

episodes:4887.name: A Lethal Love
episodes:4887.summary: A father and his two children are found murdered. Investigators soon find themselves targeting an unexpected suspect.

episodes:4887.name: Grim Obsession
episodes:4887.summary: A successful businessman falls into a relationship with a wild young woman, that ends with his shooting death.

episodes:4887.name: Jarring Jealousy
episodes:4887.summary: On March 9, 2013, 21 year old, Shadae Taylor-Brooks' body was found deceased in her apartment in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. A terrifying picture of jealousy and abuse will emerge and the circumstances surrounding her death will prove to be a challenge for authorities.

episodes:4887.name: A Scorching Suspicion
episodes:4887.summary: On December 30, 2010, University of Florida student, Saleha Huuda's charred body is found along a roadside brushfire in Gainesville, Florida. Detectives learn that Saleha's 21 year old boyfriend, Antonio Drayton, was seeing other women. With their relationship based on a history of abuse, lies and betrayal, anyone could be the killer.

episodes:4887.name: Metered Murder
episodes:4887.summary: A cabbie is found murdered in his cab, and investigators discover family secrets and lies.

episodes:4887.name: A Deadly Message
episodes:4887.summary: Police investigate bags of dismembered body parts found around town.

episodes:4887.name: The Devil You Know
episodes:4887.summary: A young mother vanishes after falling in love with a man.

episodes:4887.name: Death Toll
episodes:4887.summary: Gunfire shatters the world of a tollbooth worker and her security guard lover.

episodes:4887.name: Old Habits Die Hard
episodes:4887.summary: A troubled teen is murdered in his car after moving in with family members.

episodes:4887.name: Crippled by Blood
episodes:4887.summary: A teen mother and her brother are found shot to death in their home.

episodes:4887.name: Entrepre-murder
episodes:4887.summary: The 2009 disappearance of Lesley Davis and her husband Lyle Herring are investigated in Los Angeles.

episodes:4887.name: The Iris of Evil
episodes:4887.summary: The 2006 murder of Ericka Graham in Toledo, Ohio, is investigated. The victim was shot to death in her apartment. Her boyfriend, Charles McDonald, is the chief suspect.

episodes:4887.name: Blazed Outrage
episodes:4887.summary: A single mom falls for a charming man but their romance goes up in smoke due to a crime of terrifying proportions.

episodes:4887.name: Sin for the Son
episodes:4887.summary: A Caribbean mother moves to Toronto for a better life but ends up in a house of horrors.

episodes:4887.name: What Lies Beneath
episodes:4887.summary: In the season premiere, a football player becomes a prime suspect when his girlfriend goes missing and detectives expose a trail of lies, cheating and murder amongst other players.

episodes:4887.name: Excess Baggage
episodes:4887.summary: A woman's disappearance is investigated, unearthing a tale of violence, deception and disguise.

episodes:4887.name: Hidden Homicide
episodes:4887.summary: An Iraqi war veteran goes missing only for her body to reappear on her house's front lawn, and the investigation reveals things aren't as they seem.

episodes:4887.name: Two-Timing Terror
episodes:4887.summary: A woman disappears after reconnecting with an old flame.

episodes:4887.name: Social Media Murder
episodes:4887.summary: A brutal stabbing results in the death of a high school football player and a friend and the investigation reveals an unlikely killer.

episodes:4887.name: Blood in the Bayou
episodes:4887.summary: A beautiful woman is kidnapped in broad daylight and the investigation unearths a twisted tale of treachery.

episodes:4887.name: Badge of Betrayal
episodes:4887.summary: A police officer vanishes after an affair with a female inmate.

episodes:4887.name: Sex, Drugs and Murder
episodes:4887.summary: A couple are attacked in a hail of gunfire, and investigators find they were targeted because of sexual habits.

episodes:4887.name: High-Rise Hit
episodes:4887.summary: A car salesman is killed, unearthing a tale of passion, deceit and jealousy.

episodes:4887.name: A Plot to Kill
episodes:4887.summary: A man is brutally murdered by an unexpected killer.

episodes:4887.name: She Never Came Home
episodes:4887.summary: A college student disappears and the investigation reveals a possible love triangle.

episodes:4887.name: Blood and Black Magic
episodes:4887.summary: A woman's murder reveals dark secrets behind her and husband's seemingly perfect life.

episodes:4887.name: Family Massacre
episodes:4887.summary: The murder of a woman, her three children and her mother leads detectives on a shocking investigation.

episodes:4887.name: Hidden Agenda
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is assaulted in a series of strange, brutal attacks and investigators uncover a story of deception, jealousy and rage.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Ultimatum
episodes:4887.summary: A high school cheerleader and class president is murdered after getting caught in a twisted love triangle in a small South Carolina town.

episodes:4887.name: Lavish Lies
episodes:4887.summary: An attack by a gunman leaves Thomas Randolph injured and his wife Sharron dead. Over the next 20 years, Thomas pulls through and creates a life the rich and famous would envy, but detectives are about to expose two shocking co-conspirators in his wife's murder that will turn his world upside down.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Double Life
episodes:4887.summary: A social worker is murdered in her truck and authorities unearth a dark secret.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Trio
episodes:4887.summary: A young executive is shot and killed, revealing a secret love affair that stuns her friends and family.

episodes:4887.name: Killer Cult
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is reported missing soon after a four-year-old boy disappears in the same area, leading investigators down a treacherous path into a house of horrors.

episodes:4887.name: Demons of the Past
episodes:4887.summary: A recovering addict is gunned down outside his home after getting his life seemingly back on track.

episodes:4887.name: Road Trip Terror
episodes:4887.summary: A 56-year-old woman is killed when her truck catches fire, exposing a romance that turned deadly.

episodes:4887.name: Ruthless Rivalry
episodes:4887.summary: A woman falls victim to gang warfare when she is killed in a parked car.

episodes:4887.name: Fight or Flight
episodes:4887.summary: A flight attendant vanishes and authorities find her murdered in a forest preserve.

episodes:4887.name: When the Smoke Clears
episodes:4887.summary: A woman's body is discovered in the aftermath of a fire that covers a deadly tale of obsession.

episodes:4887.name: Slaying in the Streets
episodes:4887.summary: A young man is shot by an unknown attacker and his girlfriend vanishes, leading investigators into a path of lies and deceit.

episodes:4887.name: Wrecked By Love
episodes:4887.summary: An aspiring rapper is killed in a car accident, but a funeral director makes a shocking discovery that makes police investigate the accident as a murder.

episodes:4887.name: Watcher in the Night
episodes:4887.summary: A party ends in a mass shooting and investigators discover it was a crime of passion.

episodes:4887.name: Lethal Weapon
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is fatally shot in her home, but her husband maintains she killed her herself by accident while playing with his gun.

episodes:4887.name: Into the Woods
episodes:4887.summary: A woman goes missing after an ominous threat is made against her.

episodes:4887.name: In the Line of Fire
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is shot by a stray bullet, resulting in a car accident and revealing a romance that turned violent.

episodes:4887.name: Deception in D.C.
episodes:4887.summary: A woman mysteriously dies in an apparent suicide, but evidence of foul play is soon discovered.

episodes:4887.name: A Heart Divided
episodes:4887.summary: A nurse is murdered in her home by an unknown killer.

episodes:4887.name: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes:4887.summary: A rising Chicago star disappears without a trace.

episodes:4887.name: Thicker Than Water
episodes:4887.summary: A woman's dreams evaporate following a shooting in Decatur, Georgia.

episodes:4887.name: Death Trap
episodes:4887.summary: A man is murdered on a backcountry road.

episodes:4887.name: Gone Too Soon
episodes:4887.summary: A young woman disappears and her body is found a week later and authorities examine her dating life for clues.

episodes:4887.name: Death by Secrets
episodes:4887.summary: Detectives investigate the discovery of a beautiful nursing student found shot to death inside her car.

episodes:4887.name: Without a Trace
episodes:4887.summary: A popular salon owner mysteriously disappears, revealing a story of passion, jealously and murder in a tight-knit suburban community.

episodes:4887.name: Murder in a College Town
episodes:4887.summary: A pre-med student vanishes without a trace while evidence that reveals her disappearance and murder slips by the detectives.

episodes:4887.name: Murder, M.D.
episodes:4887.summary: A doctor is found shot to death in her parking lot and the police search for the murderer with a motive.

episodes:4887.name: What Nobody Knew
episodes:4887.summary: Diamond Dunn and her mother Elzina Brown were pillars of their Bronx, New York neighborhood, where they were known as much for their warmth and charm as for their civic duty. When beautiful Diamond wins the devotion of a handsome suitor, Elzina relishes a mother's pride in seeing her daughter blissfully in love. But the dream for a happy future shatters with the crack of gunfire inside Elzina's apartment, where love lies bleeding and life hangs by a thread.

episodes:4887.name: Gasping for Air
episodes:4887.summary: A mother is killed and police zero in on two suspects: an ex-boyfriend and a strange stalker.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Divorce
episodes:4887.summary: A rocky marriage falls apart when a man's younger brother is found dead on his family's porch.

episodes:4887.name: Master of Deceit
episodes:4887.summary: A budding romance sparks envy from an past boyfriend, which makes him go to dangerous lengths to seek revenge.

episodes:4887.name: Early Morning Murder
episodes:4887.summary: A bus driver is killed on her way to work after starting a new relationship and her killer stays at large for nearly a full year.

episodes:4887.name: A Text from the Grave
episodes:4887.summary: In the sixth season premiere, a woman vanishes without a trace after moving from Trinidad to be with her long-standing boyfriend.

episodes:4887.name: Risky Rendezvous
episodes:4887.summary: A man with two lovers is found dead in his apartment parking lot and detectives are left with a large list of suspects.

episodes:4887.name: Blazing Love Triangle
episodes:4887.summary: A young woman disappears without a trace and authorities unearth a story of secrecy and jealousy.

episodes:4887.name: Dangerous Appeal
episodes:4887.summary: A husband's double life surfaces after he is shot in cold blood.

episodes:4887.name: A Deadly Snowfall
episodes:4887.summary: A teen romance turns deadly when a high school senior is killed, but mental illness proves to be an underlying factor.

episodes:4887.name: Puppet Master
episodes:4887.summary: An Air Force vet encounters a stalker from his past set on taking him for everything he's worth.

episodes:4887.name: Hair Stylist Homicide
episodes:4887.summary: A power couple face a scandal after an investigation unearths a series of lies, manipulations, and lovers.

episodes:4887.name: House of Horrors
episodes:4887.summary: A triple homicide sees two lovers killed along with one of their mothers inside their own home.

episodes:4887.name: Killer or Victim
episodes:4887.summary: A young couple are murdered by someone from their past.

episodes:4887.name: Masked Mayhem
episodes:4887.summary: A Portland woman is shot, sparking fear across the city as investigators face strange alliances, missing suspects and unclear motives.

episodes:4887.name: Internet Dating Mystery
episodes:4887.summary: A mother of four disappears after trying online dating.

episodes:4887.name: Clinical Nightmare
episodes:4887.summary: An entrepreneur takes a nightmarish turn.

episodes:4887.name: Secrets in the Storm
episodes:4887.summary: A shocking crime surfaces after a woman falls for a rising star.

episodes:4887.name: Horror at the Hotel
episodes:4887.summary: Destynee Burkes felt blessed to find true love until she's found dead in a Florida hotel room. Will simmering secrets prove her fairytale romance was really a spine-curling nightmare? With a murderous maniac on the loose, there's no telling how high the body count will climb.

episodes:4887.name: Roadside Homicide
episodes:4887.summary: When the body of Angela Alex is discovered on a secluded road, family and friends are left desperate for answers. While investigators have their theories, their case is blown wide open when it is revealed that Angela was pregnant. As they dig deeper, they learn that appearances aren't always what they seem—and for some, a secret just might be worth killing for.

episodes:4887.name: Behind Closed Doors
episodes:4887.summary: Everyone thought Megan Neely had put her checkered past behind her and found happiness in love. But when she disappears, no one knows if this is the vanishing act of a woman with her own warped agenda or something far more sinister.

episodes:4887.name: Burning Confession
episodes:4887.summary: When mother-daughter duo Cherie Adams and Curtria Duncan are found brutally stabbed to death in their burning Chicago apartment, both the community and police force are left stunned—why would anyone want to hurt this quiet, friendly pair? As the investigation heats up, detectives discover that both women had their fair share of secrets…and clandestine lovers.

episodes:4887.name: Bad Blood
episodes:4887.summary: A tragedy hits a woman and destroys a seemingly story book life.

episodes:4887.name: Shooting Spree
episodes:4887.summary: When probation officer Cynthia Rolle is found shot dead in her own driveway, police fear that a vengeful probationer might be on the loose. But before detectives can investigate further, the killer makes it clear that she was only the first victim in a string of shootings that leaves a small town terrified.

episodes:4887.name: Road Rage
episodes:4887.summary: After the tragic loss of his mother, love rescues Jeffrey Moore from the depths of despair. But a speeding vehicle will soon run him off his road to recovery. Leaving everyone asking: was this a horrible accident or something far more sinister?

episodes:4887.name: Enraged Exchange
episodes:4887.summary: When police respond to reports of a car crash, they find Floyd McLean dead behind the wheel—but not from injuries sustained in the collision. As police dig deeper into the case, they unravel the story of a family man with a lifetime of secrets that just may have gotten him killed.

episodes:4887.name: Stabbed in the Back
episodes:4887.summary: A family's worst nightmare becomes a reality when a loving husband and father is attacked in the dead of the night. After the brutal stabbing of Damario Morris, his wife tries to protect their children from the horrible truth, but as the facts of the case emerge, nothing can shield them from the truth.

episodes:4887.name: Night Terror
episodes:4887.summary: When police officer Crystal Parker is found shot to death in her bed, the entire town of East Point, Georgia is stunned.

episodes:4887.name: D.C. Disappearance
episodes:4887.summary: Yolanda Baker goes missing after a family event, and the police begin an investigation that will keep the community on edge for a decade.

episodes:4887.name: Southside Serial Killer
episodes:4887.summary: In the seaosn finale, when Chicago police find a 40-year-old woman shot dead, they have no way of knowing they're about to uncover even more carnage.

episodes:4887.name: The Eye of the Storm
episodes:4887.summary: An assailant guns down a pastor, devastating his wife; detectives need to solve two decades worth of bloody secrets.

episodes:4887.name: Hotel Horror
episodes:4887.summary: When a couple disappears from their hotel room, detectives find hidden deceit and malevolence that will end in a tragic investigation.

episodes:4887.name: Campus Crisis
episodes:4887.summary: Ardena Carter's life resembles a fairy tale, but when she vanishes, the community must band together and find her before they lose her forever.

episodes:4887.name: Twisted Affair
episodes:4887.summary: After 23-year-old Trudie Hall vanishes, scandals simmer to the surface, leading to multiple theories about what really happened to her.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Obsession
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is gunned down while sitting in a car with her boyfriend and police question if there's more to their romance than meets the eye.

episodes:4887.name: A Young Life That Ended in Tragedy
episodes:4887.summary: Mylon Lowe, a 24-year-old, is found dead in his apartment; clues point in a multitude of disturbing directions. aka Seductive Set-Up

episodes:4887.name: Grave Secrets
episodes:4887.summary: When Sherri Jackson fails to show up for work one day, her family panics. For over a year, her family, friends, and the police search for her.

episodes:4887.name: Scorned
episodes:4887.summary: In Lake City, Florida, police visit the home of Tommy Kellum during a welfare check and find themselves in the middle of a horrific homicide case.

episodes:4887.name: An Unlikely Witness
episodes:4887.summary: The police investigate the murder of a woman killed in her own home, with a surprising witness possibly able to help detectives solve the case.

episodes:4887.name: Horror at the Holidays
episodes:4887.summary: When Jerryell Foster doesn't show up for Thanksgiving dinner, her close-knit family wonders how she could disappear without a trace.

episodes:4887.name: Dear Diary
episodes:4887.summary: A 15-year-old girl vanishes from her home one night and the community is thrust into a manhunt to find her and whoever is responsible for her disappearance.

episodes:4887.name: In Cold Blood
episodes:4887.summary: Jonathan Harris has a new lease on life after receiving two kidney transplants, and looks forward to life with his girlfriend.

episodes:4887.name: Shot to the Heart
episodes:4887.summary: High school sweethearts Re'Mano and Eugenia Campbell live a fairytale life until things take a turn for the worse.

episodes:4887.name: The Secrets We Keep
episodes:4887.summary: Police search for a missing grandmother after a large quantity of blood is found in the footwell of her abandoned car.

episodes:4887.name: Wrong Turn
episodes:4887.summary: Asia Harris is gunned down in her car on a secluded, dark road, which shakes up her family. The police discover the victim had secrets of her own when they start to investigate her murder.

episodes:4887.name: Up in Flames
episodes:4887.summary: In Sacramento, California, a young woman is found dead amid ashes in her apartment. A quest for the truth opens up a Pandora's box of secrets and multiple motives for murder.

episodes:4887.name: When Death Comes Knocking
episodes:4887.summary: The future is full of promise for lovers Michael Days and Pamela Lawson, then Michael is murdered right in front of Pamela in their own home.

episodes:4887.name: Lured by Love
episodes:4887.summary: When Ka'Loni Flynn is found shot dead on a rural road, investigators wonder if she's the victim of a carjacking gone wrong, or something far more sinister.

episodes:4887.name: Devastating Disappearance
episodes:4887.summary: Young mother Ericka Bradley disappears without a trace. Police attempt to piece together the cause of her disappearance.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Ambition
episodes:4887.summary: Sixteen-year-old Arrijana Hill is stabbed to death in her home in a gated community. As police dig deeper, they uncover a tangled web of teenage drama.

episodes:4887.name: Monster Among Us
episodes:4887.summary: The authorities investigate the lives of a mother and daughter when they are both found brutally murdered in their apartment.

episodes:4887.name: Death of Deception
episodes:4887.summary: A pregnant teenager's body is found, and investigators delve into the world of adolescent drama, before they unravel a web of lies to unmask the culprit.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Ambush
episodes:4887.summary: When US Air Force Sergeant Derrick Tolliver is gunned down in an apparent home burglary, the police are called in to investigate. The crime scene doesn't add up, however, and the suspects remain at large.

episodes:4887.name: Deserted by Love
episodes:4887.summary: In Pinole, California, Alice Sin vanishes just days before her son's first birthday, and her family and friends are desperate to figure out what could have happened to her.

episodes:4887.name: Unforeseen Enemy
episodes:4887.summary: After a young mother is murdered, all of the evidence points to one suspect, but new information sends detectives scrambling when they're on the verge of closing the case.

episodes:4887.name: The Masked Killer
episodes:4887.summary: A masked gunman surprises a woman and her lover in bed; after a burst of gunfire leaves her lover dead, the woman says she can identify the disguised gunman; detectives hope that telephone records will prove her right.

episodes:4887.name: Behind Locked Doors
episodes:4887.summary: Theresa Williams was a mother of four who dedicated her life to giving love to those who needed it most. But when her sister feels in her heart something is terribly wrong, she arrives at Theresa's home to find her two youngest children wandering around outside and Theresa brutally murdered behind locked doors.

episodes:4887.name: Sinister Scheme
episodes:4887.summary: When a married couple is gunned down in their car just yards from their home, police suspect it may be a crime of passion. But at the heart of this mystery lies an unimaginable conspiracy, fueled by a far more complicated and sinister motive.

episodes:4887.name: Vigilante Justice
episodes:4887.summary: After a woman is found stabbed to death in her bed, suspicion falls on her ex-boyfriend; however, the case takes a turn when the ex-boyfriend is gunned down, prompting investigators to look at the victim's estranged husband whose love runs deep.

episodes:4887.name: Whisper in the Woods
episodes:4887.summary: The disappearance of a young mother and her three-year-old son throws a small Southern town into complete turmoil.

episodes:4887.name: Unbridled Greed
episodes:4887.summary: When a retired Chicago steelworker is gunned down outside his home, police suspect he was targeted by a street gang.

episodes:4887.name: Left for Dead
episodes:4887.summary: After a 27-year-old pregnant woman is found stabbed to death in her apartment, police are tasked with solving a double murder.

episodes:4887.name: Driven by Revenge
episodes:4887.summary: After 33-year-old Jamel Campbell is found shot dead in a Groton, Conn., hotel room, accusations of infidelity explode and bring to light a bevy of suspects.

episodes:4887.name: All for Nothing
episodes:4887.summary: In Cleveland, firefighter William Walker is gunned down outside his home; to find the killer, detectives must cut through a web of deception, but nothing prepares them for the truth.

episodes:4887.name: Signal to Kill
episodes:4887.summary: The body of a pregnant teenager is found in a park outside of Chicago, and police discover someone close to the victim with a personal motive.

episodes:4887.name: Where Evil Lurks
episodes:4887.summary: In Dale, S.C., a woman and her two children are found shot in the head; while investigators fear there could be more carnage, the cold-hearted truth will shake this community to its core.

episodes:4887.name: Poisoned Mind
episodes:4887.summary: Aspiring actress Lilius Landrum is on the verge of success, but then she is found murdered and decapitated.

episodes:4887.name: A Calculated Plot
episodes:4887.summary: After a young single mother is murdered, her secret online dating profile leads police to suspect that her killer was a spurned lover.

episodes:4887.name: Up In Smoke
episodes:4887.summary: Marcus and Lisa Toney are a Chicago power couple destined for great things when a pipe bomb kills Marcus, leaving police to wonder who would have wanted him dead.

episodes:4887.name: Secrets by the River
episodes:4887.summary: Danielle Locklear goes missing, and while her family is baffled, the community bands together to search for the missing teenager.

episodes:4887.name: Last Call
episodes:4887.summary: When a pregnant woman's body is found floating in the Hudson River, detectives suspect she has committed suicide, but as new evidence surfaces, officers realise they have a homicide on their hands.

episodes:4887.name: Bound by Love
episodes:4887.summary: Police scramble to solve the murder of a young mother found bound hand and foot in a bathtub in Phenix City, AL.

episodes:4887.name: At All Costs
episodes:4887.summary: A business owner who wins the lottery seems to have everything going for him until he is found dead inside his van.

episodes:4887.name: Last Valentine
episodes:4887.summary: After Pamela Butler vanishes, her family becomes frantic searching for answers, as authorities find no evidence of foul play or anything suspicious on her home security footage.

episodes:4887.name: Strangers in the Park
episodes:4887.summary: After a single mother is shot outside her home, investigators turn to witnesses for a list of suspects. After a gang member fleeing the scene is identified, he makes a surprising confession.

episodes:4887.name: Love on the Run
episodes:4887.summary: A Jane Doe is found burned beyond recognition in a New York state park. An hour and a half away in the Bronx, Jasmine Nunez disappears with her boyfriend.

episodes:4887.name: Bloody Superstition
episodes:4887.summary: When two immigrants from Ghana are found murdered in their million-dollar Maryland home, the search for the killer leads investigators into the world of Caribbean religion.

episodes:4887.name: Next Stop, Murder
episodes:4887.summary: After three victims are gunned down at a bus stop, no one knows who the intended target was or what the motive could be. Detectives pursue every possible angle, until finally uncovering a conspiracy with an unbelievable criminal mastermind.

episodes:4887.name: The Helping Hand
episodes:4887.summary: US Air Force Sgt P.J. Jennings Jr is always ready to lend a helping hand, then he is found murdered in his apartment. After finding a clue, police are forced to consider the possibility that P.J.'s selflessness may have led to his demise.

episodes:4887.name: Swipe Right for Murder
episodes:4887.summary: When a contractor is found murdered, suspicion falls on the women he met through a dating app. The police suspect a crime of passion, but it turns out to be a conspiracy resulting in the death of a man who was just trying to do the right thing.

episodes:4887.name: Caught in a Lie
episodes:4887.summary: When a woman is killed in what looks like a home invasion, police quickly hone in on two suspects.

episodes:4887.name: Bonds of Love
episodes:4887.summary: When a hardworking nurse is shot and left on the side of the road, police don't know who could have wanted to kill her.

episodes:4887.name: Acts of Rage
episodes:4887.summary: When a transgender woman goes missing from a small town, police suspect she may have disappeared in order to complete her transition.

episodes:4887.name: A Shot in the Crowd
episodes:4887.summary: When a 21-year-old woman is shot dead in a bad part of town, police have to find out if it was gang related or perhaps a twisted love triangle.

episodes:4887.name: Shot in the Dark
episodes:4887.summary: When a high school cheerleader is found murdered, police question whether she was killed by a jealous rival who hoped to take her place as prom queen.

episodes:4887.name: Runaway Love
episodes:4887.summary: When a 26-year-old mother goes missing, no one knows what to think. Could she have had an accident? Or could she have run away to start a new life?

episodes:4887.name: Engaged to Murder
episodes:4887.summary: When a mother of three is found shot to death in her bedroom, her fiancé is the prime suspect.

episodes:4887.name: Holiday Homicide
episodes:4887.summary: In Detroit, Michigan, a cop's wife is killed in what looks like a botched robbery; as secrets simmer to the surface, police suspect a more personal motive; the pieces of the puzzle don't fit until a shocking confession blows the case wide open.

episodes:4887.name: Flames of Betrayal
episodes:4887.summary: Firefighters responding to an apartment fire make a grisly discovery: the charred body of a young woman; detectives investigating the case wonder if this is the work of a killer who murdered four people only a few days earlier.

episodes:4887.name: Lying in Wait
episodes:4887.summary: When a decorated Navy commander is found dead in a hotel room, those close to him suspect suicide; when autopsy results point to homicide, investigators sort through numerous lies to uncover a calculated plot fueled by lust and greed.

episodes:4887.name: Fueled by Rage
episodes:4887.summary: Two carpooling commuters find the body of a woman whose throat was slashed in a parking lot; the savage wounds suggest that the murder was a crime of passion fueled by rage.

episodes:4887.name: One Step Ahead
episodes:4887.summary: University student Corey Robinson ends up dead in an extended-stay hotel room; while sifting through his love affairs, investigators catch wind of a mysterious person whose true identity must be revealed in order to solve the crime.

episodes:4887.name: Blazing Deception
episodes:4887.summary: After Monica Sykes disappears, questions start swirling around the men in her life, including a current boyfriend, a recent ex and a young police officer.

episodes:4887.name: An Unlikely Mastermind
episodes:4887.summary: When Paul Shealey is found shot in the head in a creek, there's no shortage of suspects; as detectives learn about Paul's criminal past, multiple exes and flashy lifestyle, it seems like he may have been an easy target.

episodes:4887.name: Web of Seduction
episodes:4887.summary: After single mother Amber Owens disappears, police uncover a slew of complicated relationships involving her children's father, her new boyfriend and the women both men were seeing on the side.

episodes:4887.name: Hiding in Plain Sight
episodes:4887.summary: When LaJoya McCoy's close-knit family requests a welfare check after they haven't heard from her in days, all signs point to foul play; investigators race to find the missing mother of two, dead or alive.

episodes:4887.name: Killer on the Run
episodes:4887.summary: When a young single mother goes missing, police focus on the men in her life: her child's father, a disappointed ex, and her current boyfriend; but the investigation takes a new direction when her boyfriend is also nowhere to be found.

episodes:4887.name: False Redemption
episodes:4887.summary: When newlywed Trina Winston goes missing, her family assumes she's fallen back into old drug habits she's worked so hard to defeat.

episodes:4887.name: Mask of a Killer
episodes:4887.summary: When the family of Shalisa O'Dell find her beaten to death at home, police immediately look at her boyfriend and ex as suspects; but as they uncover more about Shalisa, including her moonlighting job at a gentleman's club, the suspect list grows.

episodes:4887.name: Storm of Lies
episodes:4887.summary: Pregnant mother Megan Price is found dead in her home; there's evidence that multiple people didn't want her new baby to see the light of day.

episodes:4887.name: Grave Betrayal
episodes:4887.summary: When a former Miss Bahamas contestant disappears in Florida, her family fears something horrible has happened to her.

episodes:4887.name: Masked Secrets
episodes:4887.summary: A young Detroit woman seems to have it all -- a loving family, a doting boyfriend, an exciting new job -- until one day, she inexplicably goes missing.

episodes:4887.name: Capital Murder
episodes:4887.summary: When a hardworking mother of three disappears during her lunch hour, investigators wonder who could have targeted her and why; after police finally find her body dumped in a field, they shift their focus to the men in her life.

episodes:4887.name: Field of Deception
episodes:4887.summary: When a young mother is found shot dead, investigators uncover a twisted web of jealousy and a love triangle that could be to blame.

episodes:4887.name: Casualty of Love
episodes:4887.summary: When an Army sergeant home on leave is gun downed on New Year's Eve, police suspect the straight-arrow soldier may have been killed over beef with someone from his past.

episodes:4887.name: Without Warning
episodes:4887.summary: When a homeowner in a troubled Brooklyn neighborhood is gunned down at his front door, police suspect a robbery gone bad.

episodes:4887.name: Victim of Success
episodes:4887.summary: She was in love and enjoying a life of glitz and glamour, until she became the victim of an unlikely kidnapping turned murder.

episodes:4887.name: A Mother's Intuition
episodes:4887.summary: When a young woman goes missing after a night out with friends, her family fears the worst.

episodes:4887.name: When a Killer Goes Free
episodes:4887.summary: When a single mom disappears after celebrating Independence Day in Milwaukee, her family immediately knows something is wrong.

episodes:4887.name: Murder in Midtown
episodes:4887.summary: When a young woman never returns to work after her lunch break, friends and family worry that she's missing. But when her mother goes to check on her, the truth is even more devastating - her daughter has been shot to death in the bathroom of her apartment. As investigators dig into the case, they'll uncover a love triangle and a series of 911 calls that will lead them to a cold-blooded killer.

episodes:4887.name: A Concrete Alibi
episodes:4887.summary: A young, Memphis wife and mother seemed to have it all, until she disappears without a trace one morning. As investigators uncover affairs, stalking, and even arson, they realize finding her won't be easy. And when the truth is finally revealed, it's nothing anyone could have imagined.

episodes:4887.name: A Fallen Star
episodes:4887.summary: An Atlanta rapper who is on the verge of stardom is shot dead; evidence on the scene seems to point to a straightforward case of self-defense.

episodes:4887.name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
episodes:4887.summary: A brilliant, beautiful college student goes missing; the case takes one shocking turn after another.
