episodes:4887.name: A Wicked Rival
episodes:4887.summary: On January 13, 2017, 34 year old, Julii Johnson is gunned down in front of her boyfriends house in Warren, Michigan. When detectives find a half million dollars hiding in her boyfriends house they wonder if this is what cost Julii her life.

episodes:4887.name: Out of Luck
episodes:4887.summary: A young woman disappears without a trace and evidence suggests she may not be coming back. To find her, investigators will have to root out a dark secret and hope that their killer is ...

episodes:4887.name: A Call for Help
episodes:4887.summary: A teenage girl is shot during a confrontation between her current and former boyfriends; her call for help to 911 leads police to conclude it's an open-and-shut case.

episodes:4887.name: A Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
episodes:4887.summary: When a reformed wild child settles down with the man of her dreams it seems as if everything is falling into place — until she's found murdered.

episodes:4887.name: Meeting a Murderer
episodes:4887.summary: When a responsible 16-year-old girl vanishes, her family fears the worst. Could she have been kidnapped, or even trafficked? As police and family search for her, a shocking story soon surfaces revealing she kept a deadly secret, and the terrible truth of what happened hits far closer to home.

episodes:4887.name: Writing on the Wall
episodes:4887.summary: A menacing message scrubbed on the wall of the murder victim's home reads, "You gave me HIV." But was that the true motive behind her gruesome stabbing death? Or was her killer just creating smoke and mirrors?

episodes:4887.name: Serial Confessions
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is found dead inside a motel room, and police quickly learn that she was an escort; there are multiple suspects, from her last client to her latest boyfriend, but the investigation puts the police on the trail of a serial killer instead.

episodes:4887.name: Never to Return
episodes:4887.summary: A single mother seems happy and in love, but then, she disappears without a trace. Rumors swirl that a troubled past has returned to haunt her, but the truth, which has forced her children to bare a horrible secret, is even more shocking.

episodes:4887.name: Hidden Connections
episodes:4887.summary: When a young mother is gunned down outside her apartment, the police immediately have a lot of questions; the investigation reveals several possible suspects , her current and previous beaus, and multiple women who may be angry about her pregnancy.

episodes:4887.name: An Envious Execution
episodes:4887.summary: After a hail of gunfire leaves two people dead, police quickly identify a suspect, but they struggle to pin him for the crime until a strange coincidence makes them realize he's already in their crosshairs for another murder.

episodes:4887.name: Blazing Betrayal
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is found dead in a suspicious house fire.

episodes:4887.name: A Revival's Revenge
episodes:4887.summary: A loving mother is killed in a violent hit and run and police initially suspect this was a tragic accident; shocking evidence surfaces that proves this woman was brutally targeted.

episodes:4887.name: A Key Witness
episodes:4887.summary: A young mother is found stabbed to death in her tub, and police first suspect her recent ex, but he produces an airtight alibi; when it looks like the case may never be solved, a frightened witness finally finds the courage to come forward.

episodes:4887.name: The Devil Within
episodes:4887.summary: Shortly after a large worker's comp settlement gave one family a chance at a good life, the husband and father is found dead in his truck; as police expose dark secrets, they're led to a cold-blooded killer nobody expected.

episodes:4887.name: Friendly Fire
episodes:4887.summary: When the body of a young woman is found in a vacant lot, friends she was out with the night she disappeared tell police they saw her leave in a mysterious black car.

episodes:4887.name: Caught in a Web
episodes:4887.summary: A young man survives a near fatal shooting, rebuilds his life, and starts looking for love, only to disappear without a trace.

episodes:4887.name: Blinded by Love
episodes:4887.summary: When a kindhearted janitor is beaten to death in his home, it doesn't take long to learn he was embroiled in a love triangle with his wife and a close friend.

episodes:4887.name: Devil in Disguise
episodes:4887.summary: When a nursing student disappears, suspicion immediately falls on her boyfriend and the other woman in his life; police struggle to pinpoint a suspect until a guilty conscience leads them to her body -- and her killer.

episodes:4887.name: The Evil Within
episodes:4887.summary: A bright, young scientist is brutally murdered at work without witnesses; detectives struggle to identify the killer until he's found hiding in plain sight.

episodes:4887.name: Chasing a Monster
episodes:4887.summary: A missing persons case takes a heartbreaking turn and launches a manhunt when detectives discover a body in an abandoned car.

episodes:4887.name: An American Nightmare
episodes:4887.summary: When a loving and successful married couple meets a deadly fate, will investigators discover a trail of dark secrets?

episodes:4887.name: What's Done is Done
episodes:4887.summary: A woman is found dead by the railroad tracks in New Jersey; the victim's boyfriend is the prime suspect until police discover a secret relationship she had with another man.

episodes:4887.name: Gone in the Dark
episodes:4887.summary: When a young woman disappears after a weekend with her boyfriend, her worried family wonders what could have happened; the boyfriend claims she left with a male friend, but the friend denies it; someone is lying, and detectives must find the truth.

episodes:4887.name: Downward Spiral
episodes:4887.summary: When a woman goes missing, police are reluctant to jump on the case because of her past; when they begin investigating the circumstances surrounding her disappearance, detectives find alarming evidence, leading to an even more disturbing crime.

episodes:4887.name: Death in the Desert
episodes:4887.summary: When a young man leaves his troubled life in the city behind for a peaceful desert town, he finds love among the desert heat; when he is brutally gunned down inside his own home, police wonder if his past has come back to haunt him.

episodes:4887.name: Truth Be Told
episodes:4887.summary: Police believe it was a failed drug deal when a husband and father was discovered stabbed in a motel. But can it be a more sinister reason?

episodes:4887.name: Happily Never After
episodes:4887.summary: After a former cheerleader is found dead in the trunk of her car, police find surveillance video that shows a man running from the scene. Did her fairytale romance take a deadly turn?

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Obsession
episodes:4887.summary: When a young woman arrives at the hospital with gunshot wounds, police attempt to locate the shooter; when the victim passes away, solving the case seems easier said than done until a witness reveals information that turn the case on its head.

episodes:4887.name: From Redemption to Revenge
episodes:4887.summary: An ex-con's redemption is cut short when he's found shot in his home; police soon learn that his girlfriend is also missing and may be a second victim.

episodes:4887.name: Never Saw It Coming
episodes:4887.summary: When a woman is found with a single gunshot wound to her head, her family is shocked; a free spirit and devoted mother, she loved life. As detectives dig, they question if her happiness was just a façade, or if her death was by someone else's hand.

episodes:4887.name: From Beyond the Grave
episodes:4887.summary: When a nursing student succumbs to a gunshot to the head, detectives' strongest suspects all have strong alibis; but when a recording of the victim is found, police will hear her name her own killer from beyond the grave, exposing one alibi as a lie.

episodes:4887.name: Heat of the Moment
episodes:4887.summary: A 911 call reports a trailer on fire, police arrive to find a victim lying in the front yard. Was this an unfortunate tragedy or a plan to cover up the truth?

episodes:4887.name: Death Is Forever
episodes:4887.summary: When a man is killed during an ambush in his home, police aren't certain if this was a botched robbery, or an intentional, cold-blooded killing; digging deeper, they discover a love triangle that led to a jealous rage with dire consequences.

episodes:4887.name: Justice Served Cold
episodes:4887.summary: When a mother vanishes, all that's left is a gasoline-doused car, an estranged husband and a missing man who may have seen her last; police suspect foul play, but without a body or solid evidence, it will take years to bring a killer to justice.

episodes:4887.name: Game Over
episodes:4887.summary: When 27-year-old Meshach Cornwall is found dead at the bottom of a staircase, police suspect it was a tragic accident until items missing from his home suggest a robbery; as detectives dig into Meshach's online life, a devious suspect emerges.

episodes:4887.name: Undone by Arrogance
episodes:4887.summary: When a young woman's body is discovered wrapped in a trash bag and dumped in an Atlanta suburb, police must find who is responsible for this horrific crime; they realize that bringing her cold-blooded killer to justice will be easier said than done.

episodes:4887.name: Enraged by Envy
episodes:4887.summary: Detectives uncover a fatal love triangle, violent pasts, and intense wrath after a woman was found dead in her kitchen, her siblings immediately suspect who is responsible.

episodes:4887.name: Eyes Of A Killer
episodes:4887.summary: When a beloved caretaker is gunned down in a parking lot, an entire community is left mourning; detectives ask whether the case was a random crime or the work of a man who'd been following her.

episodes:4887.name: A Targeted Attack
episodes:4887.summary: When two roommates are found shot inside their home, barely clinging to life, detectives struggle to determine the shooter's intended target; possibilities include a robbery gone wrong, a vindictive drug dealer and a scorned former lover.

episodes:4887.name: Heartland Homicide
episodes:4887.summary: A widowed mother of four is found stabbed to death, and police suspect sexual assault; when detectives uncover a workplace romance, they wonder if the man she was seen talking to could be her killer, and Uber could be their key to cracking the case.

episodes:4887.name: Resurfaced Secrets
episodes:4887.summary: When a single mom who is working hard to get her life on track vanishes, leaving only a cryptic text message as a clue, detectives must race to find the truth before it's entombed in concrete forever.

episodes:4887.name: Intercepting a Killer
episodes:4887.summary: When a young woman and her friend are gunned down outside her parent's home, detectives struggle to find a motive; she could be collateral damage in a drive-by shooting, caught in the crossfire of a shootout, or a victim of a jealous rage.

episodes:4887.name: Over the Edge
episodes:4887.summary: When a young mother disappears after her recent struggles with post-partum depression, her family fears the worst; when her body is found at the bottom of a cliff, they wonder if she took her own life or if someone took it from her.

episodes:4887.name: A Deadly Scheme
episodes:4887.summary: When a charitable woman is stabbed to death by a panhandler, the city is left gripped with fear; as her husband calls for action, police begin to question the witness's story.

episodes:4887.name: The Price of Naivete
episodes:4887.summary: When a sheltered, small-town girl is killed in the big city, it looks like she was the unintentional victim of a drive-by shooting; police soon uncover a shocking cell phone video that could be the smoking gun needed to break the case.

episodes:4887.name: Playing a Dangerous Game
episodes:4887.summary: When the grisly remains of a beloved football coach are found in his Texas home, detectives and loved ones desperately search for answers. Did he become a victim of his secret lifestyle, was he hunted for his debts, or was this a crime of passion?

episodes:4887.name: The Blade of a Broken Heart
episodes:4887.summary: A young father who was excited to watch his sons grow up is fatally stabbed on Thanksgiving weekend. When detectives uncover a love triangle, they question the motive behind his murder and find a killer determined to have their pie ... and eat it too.

episodes:4887.name: A Picture Worth a Thousand Words
A Love That Won't Let Go
Disastrous Dreaming
episodes:4887.summary: After fulfilling her American dream, a woman suddenly disappears. Police suspect foul play. With her family's help they zero in on a suspect. But once she is found brutally slain, they're afraid her killer has slipped through their fingers.

episodes:4887.name: Harlem Horror
episodes:4887.summary: A loving grandmother's house becomes the center of a double murder investigation.

episodes:4887.name: The Company You Keep
episodes:4887.summary: When a single mother vanishes without a trace, friends and family fear the worst. As detectives piece together the evening of her disappearance, a scorned lover fueled by bitter resentment emerges at the heart of the investigation.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Dating Game
episodes:4887.summary: When a beloved cancer survivor is found dead on the side of a rural highway, police fear her blossoming dating life played a role in her tragic demise. As detectives retrace her final days, they discover an obsessive killer hiding in plain sight.

episodes:4887.name: Familial Lies
episodes:4887.summary: When a dedicated security guard is found murdered in her apartment, police initially suspect a fatal home invasion. But as detectives interview their victim's friends and family, they discover an unassuming assailant consumed by jealousy and greed.

episodes:4887.name: Flames of Revenge
episodes:4887.summary: When a young teacher and animal lover abandons her dogs for days, her family knows something is wrong; during the search, investigators receive a tip from loved ones, leading them to investigate a tumultuous past that blows the case wide open.

episodes:4887.name: Unmasking a monster
episodes:4887.summary: A healthcare worker goes missing

episodes:4887.name: A Volatile Situation
episodes:4887.summary: When a young boy discovers his pregnant mother fatally shot inside their home, investigators are determined to bring her killer to justice. As they uncover details about her love life, a killer driven by a heartless motive emerges.

episodes:4887.name: The Cost of Loyalty
episodes:4887.summary: After surviving the murder of her mother as a child, a young woman from the Bronx grows up to become a victim's advocate. When her dismembered body is found in a park, the community is stunned.

episodes:4887.name: Deadly Double-Cross
episodes:4887.summary: Two friends disappear during a shopping trip and when they're found brutally murdered days later, stunning secrets and shocking theories about an affair begin to emerge; law enforcement must race to find their killer and bring them to justice.

episodes:4887.name: Pursuing a Phantom
episodes:4887.summary: When a nurse is abducted outside of her workplace, police race to locate her. But hope fades when video is uncovered of a mysterious man cleaning out her car and the woman nowhere to be seen. With leads drying up, will they find the killer in time?

episodes:4887.name: Trapped in a Twisted Fairy Tale
A Sinster Rage
episodes:4887.summary: When a popular bartender is found in her burning apartment, police suspect she is the victim of an arson fire; but will the autopsy reveal a more tragic death? Detectives work to uncover who was in the apartment that night and where they are now?

show:arrival.name: Dead on Arrival
show:arrival.summary: Moving to the big city to chase your dreams is a classic American story. And every year, thousands of fresh-faced young men and women abandon their small town roots in favor of the uncertainty and chaos of urban life. Dead on Arrival follows naïve newcomers who quickly learn that the city streets are not only teeming with excitement and opportunity, but also riddled with crime and violence. Caught in the hustle of city living, these innocent young adults are set on a dangerous trajectory the moment they set foot in a new city-they are Dead on Arrival - unfortunate victims of their own ambitions and dreams.

episodes:7934.name: Fatal Obsession
episodes:7934.summary: Rebecca Schaeffer moves from quaint Eugene, Oregon to become a Hollywood actress and soon has a starring role in a hit sitcom; but she soon learns that fame has a dark side more terrifying than she ever could have imagined.

episodes:7934.name: Dance with the Devil
episodes:7934.summary: Catherine Woods moves to New York City from small town Ohio to pursue her dream of dancing on Broadway; when she gets caught in a volatile love triangle, her big city dream gets lost in a nightmare of obsession and violence.

episodes:7934.name: Not in Kansas Anymore
episodes:7934.summary: Amy Watkins moves from her hometown of Topeka, Kansas to New York City to pursue her dream of being a social worker; despite her best intentions, Amy comes face to face with the terrifying dark side of the mean city streets.

episodes:7934.name: Rock n Roll Nightmare
episodes:7934.summary: Tim Moreau leaves his Louisiana hometown to join the cutting-edge music scene in Portland, Oregon; when he gets a job at a major rock club, he learns that the scene has an evil underbelly and is caught in a web of corruption and murder.

episodes:7934.name: Hospital of Horrors
episodes:7934.summary: Kathryn Hinnant moves from small town South Carolina to New York City to pursue a career in medical research; when she gets a job at legendary Bellevue Hospital, she encounters a horror so shocking the entire city is gripped with fear.

episodes:7934.name: The Road to Hell
episodes:7934.summary: After high school, Kristi Johnson leaves her small Michigan hometown to pursue a movie career in Los Angeles; when a slick casting agent lures Kristi to an audition that isn't what it seems, her Hollywood dream becomes a shocking nightmare.

show:the mechanic.name: The Mechanical Universe... and Beyond
show:the mechanic.summary: Produced starting in 1985, the videos make heavy use of historical dramatizations and visual aids to explain physics concepts.

show:the hunted.name: The Hunt
show:the hunted.summary:
The Hunt - a heart-pounding, high-stakes game of predator versus prey, where there is only one rule – hunt or be hunted.

Deep in a vast unforgiving forest, contestants are dropped into the ultimate real-world game of hide and seek - where losing means walking away with nothing and winning could mean pocketing up to £100,000. Surviving the game isn't about being the fastest. It's about being the smartest.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 1
episodes:82606.summary: In this opening episode, the players arrive at basecamp and meet for the very first time before being split into prey and predators. As the first hunt gets underway, an initial alliance is shattered by betrayal.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 2
episodes:82606.summary: The players discover who is the first to be culled. The group barely have time to recover from this shocking revelation before day two dawns and the hunt begins again. One friendship faces the ultimate test in the heat of the moment, while the breaking of a secret deal leads to a fiery clash back at base. With loyalties divided and trust called into question, the players with power must choose who to keep in the contest.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 3
episodes:82606.summary: Day three of the reality contest gets under way, with eight remaining in the battle to win up to £100,000. While one contestant approaches the upcoming hunt with supreme confidence, another decides it's time to abandon their role as underdog and come out fighting. Strategies shift and fortunes flip in the forest, and a dramatic twist turns the game on its head, putting even the strongest players in peril ahead of a tense and unexpected climax.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 4
episodes:82606.summary: The Predators ruthlessly round on one player and cracks form in a friendship. As politics and power plays kick in, who'll be culled next?

episodes:82606.name: Episode 5
episodes:82606.summary: Predator turns on Predator, but will it pay off? One player goes all in on their biggest threat, and a fiery clash sets rivalries alight.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 6
episodes:82606.summary: With five Predators and two Prey, the players face a brutal reset - and a shock decision delivers the biggest upset of the game so far.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 7
episodes:82606.summary: The sixth hunt gets underway, and a first-time Predator's ruthless pursuit is soon rewarded, even if it's not the capture some were hoping for. Alliances chop and change, and the Predators join forces to hunt one unlucky player, who assumes their fate is sealed. But back at basecamp, a last-minute plot turns the game on its head.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 8
episodes:82606.summary: The final five players embark on their most important hunt yet. With one player still reeling from losing their last remaining ally, rivalries are at an all-time high and the last two Predators are determined to guarantee their place in the final. But as the Prey desperately try to evade capture, a last-minute move threatens one player's place in the contest.

episodes:82606.name: Episode 9
episodes:82606.summary: It's the final, and just one hunt stands between the four remaining players and a prize of up to £100,000. But the last hunt comes with a fiendish twist and big-money challenges, meaning the players must deploy every ounce of skill, speed and determination to stay in the game.

show:sahara.name: Sahara
show:sahara.summary: In Sahara, Bram Vermeulen crosses the largest sand desert on earth

show:flight.name: In Flight
show:flight.summary: Jo Conran is a single mum working as a flight attendant. Her son is serving a fifteen-year sentence in a Bulgarian prison for a murder he swears he did not commit. Jo is approached by a gang who know all about her son and is blackmailed into using her job to smuggle drugs. She soon finds herself pulled into a murky underworld of corrupt cops and hired killers, forced to carry out their orders with no escape in sight. However, no matter how far Jo finds herself from her old life, her mission remains the same, to keep her son alive.

episodes:85601.name: Episode 1
episodes:85601.summary: After a fight outside a bar in Sofia, 19-year-old Sonny Conran is convicted for the murder of a member of an infamous criminal family. His mother Jo, a flight attendant, is blindsided by a threat to her son's life, but is then told she can keep him safe by agreeing to take on an additional role at work - as an international drug smuggler.

episodes:85601.name: Episode 2
episodes:85601.summary: Left with no choice but to continue Cormac's international drug runs, Jo turns to her ex, Dom, for help. Following a close call with the police, Jo is forced to quickly secrete heroin in the airport, but it goes missing - and Cormac gives her 24 hours to get it back. Meanwhile, a rattled Dom attempts to flee with his family. But after failing to convince wife Mel they need a holiday, he turns to Jo for comfort and they vow to fight back.

episodes:85601.name: Episode 3
episodes:85601.summary: Jo rushes to Sofia when Sonny is stabbed in prison. While keeping vigil at his bedside, she gets caught up in a second attempt on Sonny's life and struggles to accept Cormac's claims of non-involvement. Having enlisted the help of his former police partner, Shana, Dom is told that the Met have zero intel on Cormac. Dom deduces that he must be a small-time bully with no real connections, but then witnesses Cormac murdering a man on the street. Meanwhile, Jo returns home to a surprise visitor who delivers some shocking news.

episodes:85601.name: Episode 4
episodes:85601.summary: Dom warns Jo that Cormac is extremely dangerous but she ignores his advice and follows him to a meeting with an unknown boss. A veiled threat makes Mel suspicious and a new witness comes forward in Sonny's defence - although things do not go as expected at the appeal hearing. Jo is told to run - but instead, she and new ally Kayla come up with a new plan.

episodes:85601.name: Episode 5
episodes:85601.summary: After stealing the heroin and money, Jo realises Cormac is also being blackmailed, so they collude to get out for good. Smuggling more heroin, they sell it on, while Cormac puts things in place for Jo's escape. Kayla gives birth, and Shana reveals to Dom that Cormac's boss is Anton Marquis - a senior police officer.

episodes:85601.name: Episode 6
episodes:85601.summary: Jo demands answers and finally uncovers the truth in Sonny's case. She and Cormac execute their escape plan, though she remains uneasy as to whether he can be trusted.

show:the island.name: The Island
show:the island.summary: Limited series based on Adrian McKinty's upcoming novel described as an intense thriller that tells the story of a family trip that turns into a living nightmare.

show:the andromeda strain.name: The Andromeda Strain
show:the andromeda strain.summary: In The Andromeda Strain, a U.S. military satellite crashes in a small town and unleashes a deadly plague killing all but two survivors. As the military quarantines the area, a team of highly specialized scientists is assembled to find a cure to the pathogen code-named "Andromeda," and a reporter investigates a government conspiracy only to discover what he is chasing wants him silenced.

episodes:3890.name: Part 1
episodes:3890.summary:
Workaholic Dr. Jeremy Stone has to initialize the top-secret national emergency plan he devices in a facility also planned by him when a mysterious, viciously rapid disease strikes a Utah backwater, actually after a small meteorite strike. His small team of scientists and specialized military doesn't realize one of them is in league with the infamous general George W. Mancheck, whose top-secret project is somehow entangled with the plague.

The plague-bringing 'meteorite' is found, actually a military satellite from general Manchek's top-secret project. Dr. Jeremy Stone's team works out the virulent organism found on it has 'alien' properties, yet its anatomy suggests lab-design. Tests on it and survivors study reveal radiation would only strengthen it, just before an atomic bomb is to be dropped, but the pilot is affected by the now bird of prey-spread organism.

episodes:3890.name: Part 2
episodes:3890.summary:
Dr. Jeremy Stone's team desperately examines the staggeringly rapid and radical mutations of the Andromeda organism, which thus obtains carriers and eats trough anything, even the pilot's breathing pipe so as to accidentally cause the atomic bomb to be dropped after all. At first sight purely academic speculation ranging from philosophy to astro-biology combined with observing the temporary survivors yield crucial findings of the sulfuric acid-based enemy. The organism is constructed, communicating like an ants army. Pountless detail in its design puzzles them, until the idea of a messenger function is varied to the organism being the medium, readable in ASCII because sent from the future. Meanwhile the military-political cover up plot thickens, and reporter Nash escapes.

Dr. Jeremy Stone's team successfully tests the bacteria-based cure, then decides to destroy all samples, fearing for communication, while racing against time to produce enough while the pest spreads. The military-political conspirators however blackmail a member to keep one, which frees itself and thus starts the auto-destruct, which proves extremely hard to shut down. Meanwhile escaped reporter Nash is chased by troops and the cover-up continues after the organism is eradicated.

show:the black cat.name: The Classroom of the Black Cat and a Witch
show:the black cat.summary: Spica Virgo is an apprentice witch, but can't use any magic. She needs someone to be her master in order to get into the academy of her dreams, but she has no money and no connections. Suddenly, a mysterious talking black cat that can use magic appears before her!! Spica wants to learn magic, and the black cat wants his curse broken—goals on the same path. Therefore, a secret master-apprentice relationship was born! But the key to breaking the curse is kissing his…?!

show:the car.summary: Buying a classic or exotic car, fixing it up and selling it equals profit. It seems like a good formula to make money, but it's not as easy as it sounds, to which Jeff Allen and Perry Barndt can attest. As they prove, it takes a certain type of person who's willing to take a gamble in order to make money in the car-flipping business, because a flip doesn't always result in profit. Jeff and Perry travel the country looking for cars they can buy low and eventually - they hope - sell high.

show:dracula.name: Dracula
show:dracula.summary: In Transylvania in 1897, the blood drinking Count is drawing his plans against Victorian London. And be warned: the dead travel fast.

episodes:37453.name: The Rules of the Beast
episodes:37453.summary: 1897. English lawyer Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to meet a new client - and a legend is about to get fresh blood...

episodes:37453.name: Blood Vessel
episodes:37453.summary: The Russian ship The Demeter is a perfectly ordinary vessel, but her new voyage seems different. A motley collection of remarkable passengers includes one Count Dracula. Soon the crew are locked in a life-or-death struggle to stop the vampire before he reaches England. The ship of death has a new captain...

episodes:37453.name: The Dark Compass
episodes:37453.summary: Count Dracula has made it to England—a new world pulsing with fresh blood—and lays his plans to spread his foul vampire contagion. But why does he set his sights on the seemingly ordinary Lucy Westenra? And who on earth is left to stop him?

show:frankenstein.name: Frankenstein
show:frankenstein.summary: Adaption of Mary Shelley's novel about a scientist who brings life to a creature fashioned from corpses and various body parts.

show:tales from the void.name: Tales From The Void
show:tales from the void.summary:
Tales From The Void is an episodic horror anthology series adapted from the most viral and haunting stories from the depths of the internet. Based on stories from the r/NoSleep community, each tale blends genre thrills with social commentary to explore the darker side of the human psyche.

From creepy dolls to unborn children, unexplained invasions to paranormal hauntings, unsolved mysteries to serial murders, Tales From The Void draws from a wide spectrum of horror sub-genres with each episode paying homage to a classic and cult films from the eighties and nineties.

Unnerving, uncompromising, and rooted in character, Tales From The Void finds all the ways to keep you up at night.

episodes:79956.name: Into the Unknown
episodes:79956.summary:
When a mysterious black square appears in the middle of an apartment complex, suspicions develop between neighbours about the horrors it may bring. As mistrust grows, they slowly learn that the square isn't the only thing to be afraid of.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "The Black Square" by Matthew Dymerski.

episodes:79956.name: Fixed Frequency
episodes:79956.summary:
Juan and his friends spend their evenings hacking baby monitors and scaring young parents, but what happens when there's someone sinister on the other line?

Based on the r/NoSleep story "I Used to Hack Baby Monitors, One Night I Learned My Lesson" by Manen Lyset.

episodes:79956.name: Starlight
episodes:79956.summary:
Whit Barnett has always wanted to be a star, and the new game show The Magnificent Million Dollar Question seems like it could offer him that opportunity. But the show's conceit may be far darker than he could have imagined.

Based on the r/NoSleep story: "The Million Dollar Question" by Joao Ribiero.

episodes:79956.name: Carry
episodes:79956.summary:
Katie is thrilled when she learns she's pregnant, fulfilling her lifelong dream of becoming a mother. But when she learns her unborn child isn't viable, she finds that termination is not in line with her religious community's expectations.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Pro-Life" by Grayson Grume.

episodes:79956.name: Plastic Smile
episodes:79956.summary:
Growing up with addicts for parents, Abigail's only solace is an odd porcelain doll named Betsy. Only Betsy isn't like other dolls. She moves, speaks, cries - and Betsy wants Abigail to bring her to a dark tunnel in middle of the woods.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Betsy the Doll" by Rebecca Klingel.

episodes:79956.name: Whistle in the Woods
episodes:79956.summary:
Sawyer would love nothing more than to have a sleepover with her new best friend, Nola, in her giant, bougie home. But Nola's house has rules that must be followed. Rules that conceal a dark secret that arrives each night at 3:03 AM.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Something Walks Whistling Past My House Every Night at 3:03" by Travis Brown.

show:the trouble with tessa.name: The Trouble with Tessa
show:the trouble with tessa.summary:
After Tessa Fowler's skyrocketing career implodes overnight, the disgraced documentarian escapes to a small, idyllic mountain town called Lowery. It seems like the perfect place to hide: Lowery doesn't allow cellphones, doesn't have internet, and no one knows about Tessa's past.

Tessa's determination to leave their investigative days behind them disappears, however, when they find a mysterious box of recordings in their rental home's dingy basement. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage. However, when Tessa plays a tape that appears to catch a murder in progress, they can't help but start digging into this seemingly perfect town's disturbing past.

episodes:86017.name: Part One: Tessa
episodes:86017.summary: Disgraced documentarian Tessa Fowler arrives in Lowery, a quirky rural town with minimal technology, a list of rules, and a bizarre curfew siren that blares every night. Anxious to escape the city after a recent high-profile career scandal, Tessa is just happy to be someplace quiet and isolated. After their second night of hearing unsettling noises coming from the home's dingy basement, Tessa heads downstairs to investigate and discovers a mysterious box of old VHS and audio tapes. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage captured by a paranoid former tenant. However, when Tessa plays an audio tape that appears to have caught a murder in progress, their investigative instincts jump back into action.

episodes:86017.name: Part Two: Lowery
episodes:86017.summary: After spending a night going through the mysterious tapes, Tessa wakes up to more bad news from their producer, Aaron. Aaron sees lucrative potential in these new tapes - especially with the pair's impending legal fees. Tessa heads to the town's library to begin their research, only to discover that someone has ensured Lowery's past stays hidden. But Tessa finds a reference to a missing woman named Amelia Stokes who lived in the house they're currently renting. When Tessa's trip to a nearby bar doesn't go as planned, one local finally warms up to them, giving them a glimpse into Lowery's dark history.

episodes:86017.name: Part Three: The Bone King
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa comes clean about why they ran to away to Lowery, agrees to meet Freddy before curfew, and faces new threats as the strange walls of Lowery begin to close in.

episodes:86017.name: Part Four: Heir
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa returns to find that someone has taken the tapes. As strange noises rise from the basement, a surprise visit from Betsy changes everything.

episodes:86017.name: Part Five: Alone
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa's risky decision to recover stolen property leads to them getting trapped in a place not meant to be found—or escaped.

episodes:86017.name: Part Six: Troubles
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa finally learns the truth they've been chasing all along—one that changes everything they thought they knew about Amelia's fate.

show:the changeling.name: The Changeling
show:the changeling.summary: Set in a New York City no one knew existed, The Changeling focuses on the death-defying odyssey of Apollo Kagwa and Emma Valentine as they look to find out what happened to the son who was removed from them. On their voyage, they will travel through enchanted isles and haunted woodlands, meet glowing witches, demon giants and racist cops. They'll deal with the perils of personal technology and social media, toxic masculinity, the mental health of new mothers and fathers and find out if surviving a fairytale is as brutal as simply surviving in Trumplandia.

episodes:37128.name: First Comes Love
episodes:37128.summary: A bookseller from Queens meets a librarian from Virginia. They fall in love, marry, have a baby—and trigger an unimaginable series of events.

episodes:37128.name: Then Comes a Baby in a Baby Carriage
episodes:37128.summary: The exhaustion of new parenthood is taking its toll on Emma and Apollo. To make matters worse, Emma starts getting strange texts.
Emma does the unthinkable. Apollo tries to find meaning in the aftermath—and finally decides what to do with his valuable book.

episodes:37128.name: The Wise Ones
episodes:37128.summary: Apollo and Patrice make a sale to William Wheeler, who later gives Apollo stunning news.

episodes:37128.name: This Woman's Work
episodes:37128.summary: The mysterious washerwoman's ominous words leave a lasting impression. Apollo comes face-to-face with his true enemy.

episodes:37128.name: Aftermath
episodes:37128.summary: Emma finds Cal and the Wise Ones on North Brother Island, where she pieces together clues to locate a special place.

episodes:37128.name: Stormy Weather
episodes:37128.summary: Lillian reckons with a dark night from her past and records a message for her son, Apollo.

episodes:37128.name: Battle of the Island
episodes:37128.summary: Season finale. Kinder Garten's fury rips across the island, sending Cal, Apollo, and the others out into the darkness.

show:13 nights of elvira.name: 13 Nights of Elvira
show:13 nights of elvira.summary: Break out the crucifix, get some garlic, and say your prayers cause Elvira's coming for a visit. Elvira takes on some of the best of the worst modern B movies like Puppet Master, Cannibal Women in the Avacodo, Jungle of Death, and Evil Bong! Skewering them in the sexy, spooky way that only she can.
